metadata.description: Context configuration management for Claude Code and Codex collaboration, with a terminal cockpit for context history.

plugins.name: basin
plugins.description: Capture sessions, inspect branch history in `basin tui`, settle agreed context into a versioned Canon, and compile Context Packs for new threads. NOTE: the Claude Code plugin loader surfaces slash commands only — for Claude hooks run `./plugin/install.sh`; for Codex hooks run `./plugin/install-codex.sh` from the repo.
